name: Run Snowflake Command
description: This node use to run SQL command in snowflake by using details in configuration

fields.name: Name
fields.title: Task Name
fields.description: Unique name of the task in airflow DAG.

fields.name: XComPushEnabled
fields.title: Enable XCom Push
fields.description: If enabled, the task output will be pushed to XCom for use by downstream tasks. Disable it if passing data between tasks is not required.

fields.name: autoCommit
fields.title: Enable Auto Commit
fields.description: If enabled, each command is automatically committed.

fields.name: overwriteDetails
fields.title: Enable To Override details
fields.description: Enable this to manually override connection-derived settings such as warehouse, database, schema, and role. When disabled, values will be auto-filled from the selected connection.

fields.name: warehouse
fields.title: Warehouse
fields.description: Specify the warehouse to use for this operation. This will override the warehouse from the selected connection.

fields.name: database
fields.title: Database
fields.description: Enter the target database name. This value will replace the database provided by the connection configuration.

fields.name: schema
fields.title: Schema
fields.description: Define the schema to operate in. This will override the schema from the selected connection.

fields.name: role
fields.title: Role
fields.description: Specify the role to assume for this operation. This will override the role configured in the connection.
